summary: Dashboard cohort counts zeroed after background aggregation merge
description:
Issue summary:
Customer NimbusApps reports that cohort tiles on their main usage dashboard show zero counts for multiple metrics (active_sessions, token_count) intermittently after our nightly aggregation pass. The dashboard previously displayed expected values during the day and dropped to zero after the background compaction/aggregation job runs.

Impact:
- Customer cannot rely on cohort metrics for billing reconciliation and product telemetry.
- Affects 3 dashboard widgets across their org; spikes trust issues and blocked billing reconciliation for the past two compaction windows.
- Visible to customer admins and product analytics users; dashboards show zeros for historical buckets whereas raw event exports still contain rows.

Environment:
- prod cluster in us-west (dedicated tenant for NimbusApps)
- Console version: 2.14.1
- Retention engine: retention-engine v1.9.3 (compaction worker v3.2.0)

Steps to reproduce:
1) Log in as NimbusApps org admin in prod (us-west region).
2) Open "Product Usage" dashboard -> select cohort "Beta Testers (last 30 days)" and timespan last 7 days.
3) Observe cohort tiles for active_sessions and token_count show nonzero during daytime.
4) Wait for scheduled background aggregation/compaction run (00:15 UTC) or trigger compaction via internal job runner.
5) Refresh dashboard: tiles for those cohorts show 0 for all hourly buckets after merge completes.

Logs & artifacts:
- Query trace ID (console): trace:usw-3::0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
- Retention worker logs (excerpt): "INFO compaction: merged 24h buckets into 1h; dropped 42 series due to label-scope collision"
- Export of raw events for cohort (CSV) attached by customer shows rows for same buckets.
- Screenshot: dashboard_before_and_after.png attached to ticket.
steps_to_reproduce: Login to NimbusApps org admin in prod (us-west).
Open Product Usage dashboard and select cohort Beta Testers (last 30 days).
Observe active_sessions and token_count show values pre-compaction.
Refresh dashboard and observe zeroed series for hourly buckets.
logs: retention-worker[pid:8123] 2026-03-10T00:15:07Z INFO merged buckets\nretention-worker[pid:8123] 2026-03-10T00:15:07Z WARN dropped series due to label-scope collision: org=nimbusapps,cohort=beta-testers
console-query trace:usw-3::0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h - query took 342ms, returned 0 series after merge
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: aggregation merge incorrectly prunes series when label namespaces collide between transient prefix labels used by cohort join and persistent metric labels. Replayed compaction on staging with identical payload and enabled verbose logging: compaction step applied pruning rule 'drop-if-empty' earlier than the cohort-join step. Identified retention-engine PR that introduced an optimization to dedupe labels (PR #842) which may have reordered merge steps.\nSRE reproduction: ran compaction with same dataset in a sandbox; confirmed 42 series are flagged as \"dropped\" though raw events remain. Query planner returns empty result because cohort join key was rewritten to a sanitized label that the downstream index doesn't have.\nNext steps: add a canary change to compaction order and re-run for NimbusApps tenant only, add additional instrumentation around label-scope and series tombstone reasons.
resolution: Workaround provided: rolled back retention-engine to v1.9.2 for NimbusApps tenant and re-ran compaction to restore expected series counts. Engineering created hotfix branch reverting label-dedupe optimization and added an additional safety check to avoid pruning series referenced by cohort joins. Hotfix PR created and under review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/retention-engine/pull/848. Follow-up: schedule a full replay for affected windows and run reconciliation job to backfill any lost rollup counts.\nCustomer communicated workaround applied; they confirmed restored counts in two verification windows. Planned release of hotfix to production across dedicated tenants after QA signoff.
